title: Comparative assessment of the corneal endothelium following phacoemulsification surgery in patients with type II diabetes and nondiabetes

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License'; no licence URL in the article); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Age-related cataract, LOCS III nuclear sclerosis grade I-III, patients aged 50-70 years; diabetic group: type 2 diabetes with good glycemic control (HbA1c < 7); prior ocular surgery, uveitis, corneal opacities, glaucoma, trauma, pseudoexfoliation, grade IV nuclei and glucocorticoid treatment excluded

groups.description: Type 2 diabetes (HbA1c < 7): uneventful phacoemulsification (Oertli CataRhex, 2.8 mm clear corneal incision, HPMC 2%, in-the-bag IOL) by one surgeon; topical antibiotic-steroid for 4 weeks; 40 eyes of 40 patients, prospective, March 2018 to January 2019
Nondiabetic patients of the same age range operated in the same period with the same surgeon, technique and aftercare (the authors' 'nondiabetic control group'); 40 operated eyes of 40 patients

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the diabetic group (Table 2 'CCT (µ)' row 'Preoperative', column 'Diabetic group (n=40)')
series.notes: Table 2 CCT rows Preoperative, Postoperative at 4 weeks and at 12 weeks (weeks x 7/30.4375); mean ± SD in µm (unit printed as 'µ'); Topcon SP-1P specular microscope; n = 40 in the column header

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the nondiabetic group (Table 2 'CCT (µ)' row 'Preoperative', column 'Nondiabetic control group (n=40)')
series.notes: Table 2 CCT rows Preoperative, Postoperative at 4 weeks and at 12 weeks (weeks x 7/30.4375); mean ± SD in µm (unit printed as 'µ'); Topcon SP-1P specular microscope; n = 40 in the column header

exclusions.what: sjopt_226_23-t003 R14-R15 CCT mean change (preoperative/4 weeks, preoperative/12 weeks)
exclusions.reason: Change values of the same groups; the table gives the absolute CCT series (Table 2), which is used

exclusions.what: Figure 3 and Results subgroup analysis by diabetes duration (10 years or more vs less)
exclusions.reason: No tabulated means with a preoperative reference for these subgroups

exclusions.what: Table 2 ECD, CV and hexagonality rows; Table 1 baseline characteristics

notes: Prospective case-control design: both groups are operated cataract eyes; diabetes defines a patient-condition subgroup, so both groups are control role (condition in the group description). The authors' 'nondiabetic control group' is an operated group, not unoperated control eyes.
Table 3's 'Preoperative/12 weeks' CCT change of the diabetic group does not equal the difference of the Table 2 means (the other three change cells do); the absolute Table 2 values are cited.
No per-visit n besides the column header n = 40 per group; no losses to follow-up reported.
